hook: A mathematician says Claude helped prove Riemann.
hookText: Claude and a proof of Riemann?

beats.say: Mathematician Levent Alpöge posted a short note claiming he found a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, working with Anthropic's Claude.
He says the method goes further, resolving the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis too, one of the most famous open problems in number theory.
And he says the whole argument has been formalized in the Lean proof assistant, so other mathematicians can now check it.
